scenarios.title: Kickoff, ball out, throw-in
scenarios.description: A scripted 16-second sequence: pre-match footage, kickoff, a home build-up down the right, a cross that goes out for a throw-in, the away restart, a brief home touch, and footage after the graded interval.

scenarios.title: Contested loose ball
scenarios.description: Home builds through midfield, then a loose pass starts a 60-frame scramble. Home and away each get short bursts of clear control before away wins the ball outright.

scenarios.title: Ball tracking lost
scenarios.description: Home keeps the ball down the right, then ball tracking is lost for 4 seconds. Players stay visible: away #3 tackles during the gap, and the ball reappears with away.

scenarios.title: Mistimed restart tag
scenarios.description: A home cross goes out for an away throw-in, taken at frame 135. The automatic Smart Tagging throw-in tag is placed 50 frames late, over live play.
